name: Territory Text Color Detection
description: Chooses the most readable approved palette colour for each text role (e.g. Headline, Subline) on a background-only render, using weakest-zone WCAG contrast scoring, and flags low contrast for review.

inputs.name: background
inputs.description: Final layout rendered WITHOUT the text being coloured (Headline/Subline hidden) — the pixels the text will sit on

inputs.name: textLayout
inputs.description: Text roles with glyph line boxes: { coordinateSpace, roles: [{ role, fontSizePt, lines: [[top,left,bottom,right], …] }] }

inputs.name: palette
inputs.description: Approved client colours: { swatches: [{ id, name, model, values | rgb | hex }], selectedIds? } or { aseUrl, selectedIds? }

outputs.name: colorDecision
outputs.description: Per text role: selected colour, weakest-zone and overall contrast, threshold, readability OK / LOW / NO_DATA, ranking and warnings; overall status ok | review

outputs.name: readability
outputs.description: "ok" when every role meets its contrast threshold, otherwise "review"

parameters.name: largeTextFromPt
parameters.description: Text at or above this size (pt) counts as large text

commonPatterns: Run after the layout is composed and the image is extended, before applying text colours to the final layouts
Route layouts whose readability is "review" to a human approval step
bestPractices: Send a background-only render: hide the text being coloured, keep everything else (image, extension, overlays)
Send one box per glyph line rather than the whole text frame, so empty frame areas don't affect the score
Only pass the client's approved colours; the node never picks a colour outside the palette
